name: node-robot
description: RRCA runtime — a minimal Node-RED distribution with RRCF nodes that lets a robot speak the Robot Remote Control Format. Loads an .rrcf declaration, validates commands against the declared safety envelope, and bridges normalized controls/telemetry to a vendor endpoint via a pluggable adapter.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check settings.js && node --check lib/rrcfCore.js && node --check lib/safetyEnvelope.js && node --check adapters/log.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('flows/flows.json','utf8'));console.log('flows.json OK')" && node test/load-nodes.js && node test/smoke.js && node test/bridge.js
